title: Wearable sensor system diagram (lower-limb rehabilitation)
overview: Leg sensors send motion data by radio to a belt unit. The belt passes it by Bluetooth to a phone app.
source: Sensors 2024, 24(6), 1935, CC BY, Figure 1 (check figure number on page)

stops.label: belt
stops.says: It holds an IMU, an MCU, an RF module and a BLE module.

stops.label: right thigh
stops.says: It has an IMU, an MCU and an RF module.

stops.label: right calf
stops.says: The same three parts as the thigh.

stops.label: left thigh
stops.says: Again an IMU, an MCU and an RF module.

stops.label: left calf
stops.says: The fourth and last leg module.

stops.label: smartphone app
stops.says: Motion data from the belt arrives here. The app turns it into a rehabilitation plan.
